blocking.issue: This finding is narrowed from the previous round. The crossing map, the 8091 row split and the Figure 1 `ctl` to `oci` edge are fixed. Three problems remain. (1) The pack 8.4 amendment has no Open question behind it. Control plane and GitOps closed OQ-control-plane-and-gitops-14 as "answered by Security and identity" (its line 590), and this document lists -14 as answered (line 556). The only record of the change is "(proposed pack 8.4 amendment)" in a table cell, so no document's Open questions track it. Pack section 14 requires that: "After the freeze, changes require an ADR or an entry in the owning document's Open questions." (2) Line 113 names only "pack 8.4's 8091 row and TB-5" as needing amendment. The same sentence also widens four other System overview IDs. TB-3 is "Ruralz Gateway to Upstreams and AIProviders" but would now include Vault and the Kubernetes API. TB-7 is "Ruralz Control to Git" but would now include webhooks and the Kubernetes client. TB-8 is "Node to OCI registry" but would now include Ruralz Control's registry client. TB-11 is "mTLS between Raft replicas" but would now include the token join. (3) The 8092 row still reads "mTLS, TLS 1.3 only". This document maps "token replica join to TB-11" and labels the Figure 1 edge "TB-11 Raft mTLS 8092, token join". Control plane and GitOps also redeems a one-time `admin` token in `Join` on 8092 before the replica has a peer certificate (OQ-control-plane-and-gitops-15). The row therefore contradicts the document's own mapping, which is the same defect the previous round fixed for 8091.

Line 128: "| 8091 (TB-5) | TLS 1.3; client certificate required for every RPC except `Enroll`, which needs a one-time token (proposed pack 8.4 amendment) |". Line 129: "| 8092 (TB-11), relay (TB-13) | mTLS, TLS 1.3 only | Disjoint CAs, so a Node key cannot join Raft |". Line 84: "ctl -->|\"TB-11 Raft mTLS 8092, token join\"| cst". Line 556: "Answered above: ... OQ-control-plane-and-gitops-9, -10, -14, ...". Control plane and GitOps line 590: "Closed: OQ-control-plane-and-gitops-9 (b) and -10, -14, -19, -20 (a), answered by Security and identity"; line 508: "`ruralz control join` redeems a one-time `admin` token in `Join`"; line 116: "a token `Join` (OQ-control-plane-and-gitops-15)". System overview lines 482 to 490: TB-3 "Ruralz Gateway to Upstreams and AIProviders", TB-7 "Ruralz Control to Git", TB-8 "Node to OCI registry", TB-11 "mTLS between Raft replicas on 8092". Pack 8.4: "| 8091 | ... | mTLS, per-Node enrollment certificate |".
